create_VectorNormalizer: create a VectorNormalizer instance with a given dimension and optional normalization flag
update_meta_data: update feature sums and squared sums by passing a feature vector row to the normalizer
calculate_feature_stats: calculate feature averages and standard deviations from accumulated sums after processing all rows
normalize_vectors: normalize a list of feature vectors in place using the computed mean and standard deviation
review_VectorNormalizer: review the VectorNormalizer class and its in-place normalization logic for TorchScript compatibility
